name: window_management
description:
Manage existing Windows app windows. Prefer this tool over powershell or shell commands when the user asks to find windows, check which window is foreground, activate or bring a window to front, move/resize/minimize/restore, or close application windows. Supports: list, find, activate, minimize, maximize, restore, close, move, resize, and more.
To launch apps, use the app tool. This tool manages windows AFTER they exist. For "close all" requests, first use find/list to get every matching window handle, then call close once per handle. Some apps, including modern Notepad, can have multiple tabs/windows in one process; closing one handle may leave another visible window behind. CLOSE WITHOUT SAVING: Use close action with discardChanges=true to automatically dismiss 'Save?' dialogs. NOTE: discardChanges only works on English Windows (looks for 'Don't Save' button text). Example: window_management(action='close', handle='123', discardChanges=true) Use move_to_monitor to move a window to a specific monitor: - Use target='primary_screen' or target='secondary_screen' for easy targeting - Use monitorIndex for 3+ monitor setups (use screenshot_control action='list_monitors' to find indices)
Returns: The result of the window operation including success status and window information.

action.description: The window action to perform: list, find, activate, get_foreground, get_state, wait_for_state, minimize, maximize, restore, close, move, resize, set_bounds, wait_for, move_to_monitor, move_and_activate, or ensure_visible.

handle.description: Window handle for actions that target a specific window. Get the handle from the list or find action.

title.description: Window title to search for (for find and wait_for). Uses substring match unless regex=true.

processName.description: Process name to search for (for find action). More reliable than title - matches 'Notepad', 'chrome', etc. Case-insensitive.

filter.description: Filter windows by title or process name (for list action).

regex.description: Use regex matching for title/filter (default: false).

includeAllDesktops.description: Include windows on other virtual desktops (default: false).

x.description: X-coordinate for move or set_bounds action.

y.description: Y-coordinate for move or set_bounds action.

width.description: Width for resize or set_bounds action.

height.description: Height for resize or set_bounds action.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for wait_for and wait_for_state actions (default: 5000).

target.description: Monitor target for move_to_monitor action: 'primary_screen' (main display), 'secondary_screen' (other monitor in 2-monitor setups).

monitorIndex.description: Target monitor index for move_to_monitor action (0-based). Alternative to target for 3+ monitor setups.

state.description: Target window state for wait_for_state action: 'normal', 'minimized', 'maximized', or 'hidden'.

excludeTitle.description: Window title to exclude from list results (for list action).

discardChanges.description: For close action: if true, automatically dismisses 'Save?' dialogs by clicking 'Don't Save'. Only works on English Windows. Default: false.
